purpose: Choose exactly one deterministic, no-fit Alpha158 close-distribution asymmetry mechanism for Campaign299 without reading Campaign299 candidate values, comparator values, daily prices or forward returns.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_close_distribution_upper_tail_asymmetry_20d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The frozen Alpha158 design exposes MA20=Mean(close,20)/current_close, QTLU20=Q80(close,20)/current_close and QTLD20=Q20(close,20)/current_close. The common current-close divisor cancels in (2*MA20-QTLU20-QTLD20)/(QTLU20-QTLD20). The numerator measures whether the full-sample mean is pulled above the central 20%-80% quantile midpoint, while the denominator fixes scale to the central band. This is an own-stock close-distribution tail-asymmetry mechanism, not the Campaign297 central-band occupancy inside the high-low envelope and not the Campaign298 volume coefficient of variation.

parameters.valid_input_rule: all three inputs finite; QTLU20-QTLD20 strictly positive; resulting raw ratio finite; never fill, clip, winsorize, threshold, rank, sign, absolute-value or add an epsilon
parameters.economic_hypothesis: A positive upper-tail displacement means unusually high closes have lifted the twenty-session mean above the central quantile midpoint, consistent with episodic upside demand whose information assimilation may persist from the next accepted open through the third accepted close.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_close_distribution_lower_tail_asymmetry_20d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Negating the selected score or preferring the lower direction would create a two-direction search rather than an independent mechanism. Higher upper-tail displacement is frozen once before values.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_close_distribution_asymmetry_horizon_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Trying 5, 10, 30 or 60 sessions, pooling horizons or selecting a best horizon would create a horizon search. One conventional twenty-session month is frozen.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_close_distribution_asymmetry_transform_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Absolute value, square, sign, log, clipping, winsorization, thresholds, buckets and epsilon repairs add discretionary variants and are excluded.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_raw_ma_quantile_midpoint_or_interquantile_width
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The unscaled mean-minus-quantile-midpoint mixes asymmetry with dispersion, while raw MA20 or interquantile width does not isolate tail imbalance. The single central-band-normalized form is frozen.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign297_occupancy_retune_reverse_rehorizon_or_combination
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign297 is immutable and terminal. Campaign299 does not read or transform its factor output, does not use MAX20 or MIN20, and does not measure central-band occupancy inside an envelope. QTLU20 and QTLD20 remain admissible only because they were coordinates of the complete Alpha158 feature library frozen before Campaign297.
